question: Which of the following major Indian crops requires high temperature (above 25°C) and high humidity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rice**

 
 
• **Rice **is the major **Indian crops** requires high **temperature (above 25°C)** and high **humidity**.
 
• For **Kharif** **crops**, high temperatures** (over 25 °C)** and high **humidity **are necessary.
 
• It needs annual precipitation of at least **100 cm**.
 
• It flourishes with **irrigation **in places with little **rainfall**. India's **northern **and **northern-eastern plains**,** coastal regions**, and deltaic areas are all where **rice **is farmed.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rice **is made from the seed of the **grass Oryza sativa**, often known as **Asian rice** or, less frequently, O. glaberrima** (African rice)**.
 
• Although the phrase may sometimes be used to refer to **wild **or **uncultivated **variants of **Oryza**, wild rice is typically used to refer to species of the **genera Zizania and Porteresia**.
